note: Resumed. The first run sent the setup transactions up to the vault deposit (listed first), then its rating failed after 15 minutes: the Robinhood testnet RPC no longer served the fork block's state ("historical state ... is not available"). After the fork proxy fix (packages/sandbox/src/fork-proxy.ts) the same script ran from the rating on, for agent 1 and its vault, without registering again. The script's own keeper filed the claim: the hosted keeper was still on the Oct 10 contracts.
